description: The agent-facing tool interface, identical on both sides of the model-driven comparison. The treatment backs it with the Fawn workspace service; the control backs it with Playwright agent tooling plus revalidation and takeover cancellation. Backend behavior differs; names, descriptions and schemas do not.

tools.name: observe
tools.description: Read the current page. Returns text describing the page and element ids for interactive elements. Optional regions are CSS selectors to focus on; the backend may return more than requested. With since_last, parts unchanged since your previous observation may be summarized as unchanged.

regions.description: CSS selectors of the page parts you need.

since_last.description: Report only what changed since your previous observation when possible.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Open a URL in the workspace browser. Only the application's own origin is allowed.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element from the latest observation. Name in depends_on the page parts your decision relied on; the action may be refused if they changed.

external_effect.description: True when this click changes state in the application, such as claiming, adding to a cart or deleting.

tools.name: fill
tools.description: Replace the value of a text field from the latest observation.

tools.name: submit
tools.description: Press a form's submit control. This is an external effect and must happen exactly once.

tools.name: download
tools.description: Download the file a link from the latest observation produces. Returns the saved artifact's identifier.

tools.name: pending_effects
tools.description: List your external effects whose outcome is not confirmed, with what is known about each.

tools.name: request_human_review
tools.description: Stop and ask a person to decide, when you cannot determine whether an external effect happened.

artifact.description: Identifier of a saved artifact, when the task asks for one.
